indications.description: Advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma in patients considered unsuitable for cisplatin.
Advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.
With nivolumab for neoadjuvant treatment of resectable NSCLC at high risk of recurrence with PD-L1 expression ≥1% (3 cycles).
Locally advanced, recurrent or metastatic NSCLC, including selected neoadjuvant use with nivolumab.
Advanced urothelial carcinoma where gemcitabine and carboplatin is selected.

options.label: Cycle delay >1 week due to toxicity

nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Other non-haematological toxicity grade (excluding nausea/vomiting)

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Name the event and exclude nausea/vomiting from this generic source dose row; assess those separately. Severe vomiting still needs urgent clinical assessment.
nonhaem_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: Source action table does not specify a CTCAE edition; use the locally agreed named-event grading system and confirm clinical attribution.

pneumonitis_grade.label: Pneumonitis grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Symptomatic; medical intervention indicated; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms; oxygen indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening respiratory compromise; urgent intervention such as ventilatory support required.

pneumonitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess new cough, dyspnoea, oxygen requirement, imaging findings, infection and alternative causes. Immune-related or drug-related pneumonitis requires urgent senior review when symptomatic.
pneumonitis_grade.source_grading_note: Source action table does not specify a CTCAE edition; use the locally agreed named-event grading system and confirm clinical attribution.

action.recommendation: For subsequent cycles reduce GEMCITABINE to 75% of the ORIGINAL cycle-initiation dose after the selected severe haematologic event or toxicity delay >1 week.
